inlines.v: CULPRIT, noun [supposed to be formed from cul, for culpable, and prit, ready; certain abbreviations used by the clerks in noting the arraignment of criminals; the prisoner is guilty, and the king is ready to prove him so.] 1. A person arraigned in court for a crime. 2. Any person convicted of a crime; a criminal.
